item_name: Rothco XLarge Military Style Analog & Digital Display Watch
item_short_desc: You will always get the time right with Rothco's XLarge Military Style Analog & Digital Display Watch.
description: You will always get the time right with Rothco's XLarge Military Style Analog & Digital Display Watch. This military-style watch features an over-sized face and a large, comfortable wristband. Rothco's wristwatch displays time in analog and in digital with Japan quartz movement. Additional features include a stopwatch function, alarms, both standard and military time displays, and date display including the day of the week. The watch is water-resistant (1 ATM) making it great for all kinds of outdoor activities. A light-up digit function makes the time display easy to read in the dark and the watch comes in a zinc-alloy case for storage.
